channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Rare sheep are U.S.-Mexico border crossers, but they're hitting a sharp new obstacle
item.description: Peninsular bighorn sheep have long migrated between California and Mexico, but plans to close gaps in the border wall may change that. Scientists say the animals will suffer as a result.

item.title: Portland mayor demands ICE leave the city after federal agents gas protesters
item.description: The mayor of the Oregon city demanded ICE leave his city after federal agents launched tear gas at a crowd of demonstrators — including young children — outside an ICE facility during a weekend protest.

item.title: Lakers star LeBron James named an NBA All-Star for a record 22nd time
item.description: Lakers star LeBron James was named a reserve for the 2026 NBA All-Star Game, making the midseason showcase for a record 22nd time.

item.title: Inside Clive Davis' annual pre-Grammy gala at the Beverly Hilton
item.description: The long-running party on Saturday night featured performances by Huntr/x, Sombr, Olivia Dean and Art Garfunkel, among others.

item.title: Amid immigration raids, a coalition of U.S. leaders gather in L.A. to share resistance strategies
item.description: On a warm Friday morning, a group of organizers, academics and public officials stood in MacArthur Park, peering at an empty soccer field.

item.title: A 'Sex and the City' extra wanted to build a housing complex. He must evict a Boyle Heights family first
item.description: The city stopped a Boyle Heights development over gentrification concerns, but a judge found that the city's action was illegal.

item.title: Would-be thieves in ski masks arrested after attempted Woodland Hills break-in
item.description: Three people were detained after an attempted burglary in the San Fernando Valley overnight, rattling an area that has been subject to sometimes violent break-ins.

item.title: High-speed chase of homicide suspect ends in suicide near LAX, police say
item.description: A suspect fleeing a homicide scene in Camarillo led authorities on a pursuit before taking his own life near Los Angeles International Airport.

item.title: Trump says 'dilapidated' Kennedy Center will close for 2 years for renovations
item.description: President Trump says he will move to close the Kennedy Center performing arts venue for two years starting in July for construction.

item.title: Grammys 2026: The complete winners list
item.description: Here's the winners list for the 2026 Grammy Awards, updating live. The night's major awards went to Olivia Dean for new artist, Billie Eilish and Finneas for song, Kendrick Lamar with SZA for record and Bad Bunny for album.
